component.name: exwin
component.summary: Offline Windows game manager for Linux

description.p: exwin is an offline-first Windows software and game manager for Linux. It provides a Steam-like GUI experience for managing Windows applications via Proton and Wine, with first-class support for GOG offline installers.

ul.li: Install GOG offline installers automatically via innoextract
Per-app Proton/Wine configuration with prefix isolation
DXVK and VKD3D-Proton auto-install into Wine prefixes
Proton-GE download and management from GitHub releases
Winetricks integration with per-app verb lists
Save file backup and restore
Play time tracking
Desktop shortcut creation
Headless launch mode for desktop shortcuts
Crash detection with log-tail dialog for short-run failures
Folder import for already-extracted portable games
One-click prefix upgrade via wineboot -u
Pre/post-launch hooks (ISO mount, kill processes, compositor, governor, shell)
umu-launcher integration for canonical Proton launches with ProtonFixes

description.p: Auto-detection install route, auto-configure game settings, and installer robustness fixes.

ul.li: Auto-detection install route: every installer is analysed (magic bytes, PE header, installer-stub markers, SFX payloads, multi-part sets) and a one-click install plan is proposed with reasons; manual configuration remains available
Self-extracting RAR/7z .exe archives (including multi-part sets) extract directly instead of running the Windows stub
Auto-configure: inspect the installed game and host system, preview recommended Wine/Proton and graphics settings with reasons, and apply them in one click
Sleep/idle inhibit during play, ESYNC/FSYNC/NVAPI/locale knobs, CPU affinity, CLI info and backups subcommands, .lnk shortcut resolution
Generic installer waits for wineserver idle (no more false failures from bootstrapper installers); DLC installers run from the base game's folder
Stop signals the whole process group; headless launches honour hooks; corrupt config no longer blocks startup

description.p: Eleven new features across two batches: installer types, per-game overlays, online lookups, launch hardening, and portable import.

ul.li: Archive installers (.zip, .7z, .rar) with auto-flattening and shared exe heuristics
MSI installers via wine msiexec /i
Searchable, categorised winetricks verb picker with bundled catalog fallback
Redistributable auto-scan with one-click run or equivalent winetricks verb
Per-game gamescope wrapper (FSR/NIS upscaling, HDR, frame cap, MangoApp overlay)
ProtonDB lookup with one-click apply of parsed launch args, env vars, verbs, and DLL overrides (7-day disk cache)
Crash / short-run detection with log tail, runtime, and prefix arch surfaced in a dialog
Folder / portable-game import for already-extracted Windows games
One-click prefix upgrade via wineboot -u
Pre/post-launch hooks: ISO mount, kill processes, KDE compositor, CPU governor, and /bin/sh escape hatch
umu-launcher integration with tri-state per-app override and graceful fallback

description.p: UI/UX fixes and quality improvements: dialog sizing, visual test coverage, install dialog refactoring.

ul.li: Fix collapsed dialog issue — add content_height to AppDetailDialog, InstallDialog, AppSettingsDialog, and ProtonGEDialog
Install dialog pages extracted to install_pages.py module
Visual UI test scaffold (20 automated tests) validating dialog sizing, widget tree layout, and cross-dialog consistency
Screenshot harness for automated visual regression testing under Xvfb

description.p: Feature update adding system tray icon, GOG checksum validation, play time tracking, save file backup, CLI interface, GPU selection, global storage root, and metadata cleanup on uninstall.

ul.li: System tray icon via StatusNotifierItem (DBus) — close to tray, restore on click
GOG installer checksum validation from .hashdb sidecar before extraction
Play time tracking per game, displayed on library cards and detail view
Save file backup and restore with per-app save path configuration
CLI subcommands: list, launch, remove, migrate, backup-saves, restore-saves
GPU selection per app (DRI_PRIME / DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_NAME)
Global storage root to redirect game files and prefixes to an external drive
Metadata and config directory cleanup on uninstall

description.p: Initial release with full GOG offline installer automation, Proton/Wine backend, and GTK4/libadwaita UI.
